feedback.problem: If ${e}^{t}=15,$ then $t≈${{field-1}}, rounded to $3$ decimal places.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we take $ln$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $t:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{t} & =15 \\ ln⁡({e}^{t}) & =ln⁡(15) \\ t & =ln⁡(15)\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating the above expression using a calculator gives

$$
t≈2.708
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
